title: Admin check on the raw path while the router canonicalises it
measures: Fixes a reported access-control bypass (/Admin/users) where the admin check runs on the raw request path but the router matches a canonical form (case-folded, percent-decoded, empty and dot segments resolved). Lower-casing in the check fixes the report but //admin, /%61dmin, /x/../admin and the bare /admin dashboard (the check wants '/admin/') still reach the back office, including the role-change endpoint. The robust fix decides on the same canonical path the router uses, or on the matched route.
prompt: A support agent (role support) opened /Admin/users and got the full user list with emails. The back office must be admins only. Please fix.

commits.message: feat(http): storefront api, account pages and admin back office
